title: Les plus secrets mystères des hauts grades de la maçonnerie dévoilés
shelf_note: An 18th-century French exposé of high-degree Masonic ritual. The page is ritual text for the Knight of the Sword/Cyrus degree, which matches the title. The packet gives no tradition or collections to test it against.
structure_note: There are 205 page records against pages_count 189, with 5 duplicate records. The structure count shows pages_translated 0, but the field says 177, so one of the two counters is wrong. Record 159 carries printed p.117, an offset of 42, which points to substantial front matter or an earlier sequence. The 12 backsteps and 18 repeats are more than misread numerals would explain. They probably come from the duplicate records plus a second pagination sequence (a multi-part volume), though one page cannot confirm that.

book_verdict: This is a clean page. The OCR is faithful apart from one ſ→f slip ("font" for "ſont") that the English silently corrects, and the translation is accurate. The notes are correct, but the Nehemiah allusion is the translator's interpretation and is not on the page.
